[[Sarah Natochenny]] ([[AG162]]-[[AG187]])| java1=[[Ikue Otani]]| java2=N/A| }} '''Drew's Roserade''' (Japanese: '''シュウのロズレイド''' ''Shū's Roserade'') was [[Drew]]'s first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} seen in {{aniseries|PTS}}. It is also his main Pokémon. ==In animation== ===History=== ==={{aniseries|RS}}=== =====Hoenn===== [[File:Drew and Roselia.png|thumb|220px|left|Roselia and Drew]] As a Roselia, Roserade first appeared in [[AG033|''Now'' That's ''Flower Power!'']] when Drew challenged {{an|May}} to a [[Contest Battle]] to determine who would get some [[Bluk Berry|Bluk Berries]]. It battled [[May's Beautifly]], managing to stop its {{m|Tackle}} with {{m|Petal Dance}} and {{status|Paralysis|paralyze}} it with {{m|Stun Spore}}. However, Roselia's {{m|Magical Leaf}} was overcome by {{m|Silver Wind}} and it took damage, just as {{TRT}} interrupted the match by stealing the {{Berries}}. It then destroyed their [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]] with {{m|Solar Beam}} and combined the attack with {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Thunderbolt}} to send them blasting off, allowing {{TP|May|Torchic}} to retrieve the Berries. Roselia later sat with its Trainer and watched the fireworks that were made with the Bluk Berries. In ''[[AG035|Win, Lose or Drew!]]'', Roselia was used in the [[Slateport City]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. In the Appeals Round, it finished an amazing performance by shredding Petal Dance with Magical Leaf and scoring a 29.4. Its first opponent in the Battle Round was May's Beautifly and it won the battle without taking a hit. It was later beaten in the second round by {{ho|Robert}}'s {{p|Milotic}}. In ''[[AG050|Pros and Con Artists]]'', Roselia battled [[Ash's Taillow]]. It first incapacitated Taillow with Stun Spore and won the match with Solar Beam. In the [[AG051|next episode]], Roselia was used in the [[Fallarbor Town]] Pokémon Contest, where it once again got through the Appeals Round, scoring high with a 29.6. In the Battle Round, Roselia was matched against {{ho|Grace}}'s {{p|Medicham}}. It started off with Magical Leaf, but Medicham avoided the attack by using {{m|Meditate}}. Roselia was able to easily and gracefully evade Medicham's {{m|Ice Punch}} before having its Petal Dance sent back at it by Medicham's {{m|Confusion}}. Roselia launched a Solar Beam attack, but it was blocked by a shield of ice that Medicham created with its Ice Punch, the attack reflected on the ice and struck Roselia. It was then knocked out by its opponent's {{m|High Jump Kick}}. In ''[[AG061|Disaster of Disguise]]'', it was seen being defeated by [[Timmy Grimm]]'s {{p|Dusclops}}, suffering major injuries in the process. Drew rushed Roselia to the [[Pokémon Center]] and as a result of its injuries he decided not to enter the {{to|Verdanturf}} Contest. Roselia performed in the Appeals Round of the [[Rank (Contest)|R1]] {{to|Rubello}} Contest in ''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]''. It made a gorgeous entrance with Petal Dance and managed to impress the [[Contest Judge]]s enough to send Drew through to the Battle Round. In ''[[AG113|Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?]]'', Roselia was sent out to battle [[Jessie's Seviper]] on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}} while its Trainer attempted to rescue May. It battled alongside a group of wild {{p|Wynaut}} who were trying to get back the [[Liechi Berry|Liechi Berries]] that Team Rocket stole. Roselia confused Team Rocket by using Petal Dance in the complete wrong direction; the wind blew the attack back and cut the rope May had been tied up in. It then stood back and watched {{AP|Pikachu}}, Beautifly, and {{DL|Drew|Masquerain}} finish them off. [[File:AG123.png|thumb|220px|Roselia and Flygon at the Hoenn Grand Festival]] Roselia reappeared at the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] in ''[[AG121|Hi Ho Silver Wind!]]'' when Drew was congratulating May for getting her fifth [[Ribbon]]. Later, in the preliminary Appeals Round, Roselia scored Drew a 95, sending him through to the main Appeals Round. In ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', Roselia was seen being {{pkmn|groomer|groomed}} by its Trainer along with Masquerain. In ''[[AG123|Rhapsody in Drew]]'', Roselia was chosen to battle alongside {{DL|Drew|Flygon}} in the quarterfinals against [[May's Combusken]] and {{TP|May|Skitty}}. Roselia started the battle with Petal Dance, but Skitty's {{m|Assist}} became {{m|Fire Spin}} and incinerated the move. When Flygon stole the attention and left their opponents open to attack, Roselia launched a Solar Beam along with Flygon's Flamethrower, which was stopped by Combusken's Fire Spin. Roselia dodged Skitty's next {{m|Blizzard}} attack and jumped on Flygon. When Combusken was launched up to Roselia and its partner, it launched a Magical Leaf in order to defend itself, but the move was blown away by Blizzard. Confronted by Combusken's Quick Attack and Skitty's Tackle, Roselia paralyzed them both with Stun Spore, evading their attacks and allowing Flygon to land a direct hit on {{cat|May's Pokémon}} just as time ran out. Drew won the battle on points, advancing to the semifinals. In the final round, Roselia was used alongside Masquerain against Robert's Milotic and {{p|Claydol}}. Despite Drew's determination to win the title of [[Top Coordinator]], he was unable to overcome Robert's tactics. As a result, his Pokémon ended up losing the battle on points. After the final match, Roselia was seen {{pkmn|training}} with Masquerain during the party held to celebrate all the hard-working {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s who participated in the Grand Festival. =====Kanto===== [[File:Drew Roselia Masquerain Kanto Grand Festival.png|thumb|left|250px|Roselia and Masquerain at the Kanto Grand Festival]] After Drew ended his {{pkmn|journey}} throughout the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], he traveled to Kanto to start a new [[Pokémon Contest]] circuit and brought along his Roselia. In ''[[AG162|Spontaneous Combusken!]]'', Roselia was seen enjoying some rest and relaxation at a resort on [[Chrysanthemum Island]] alongside its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Drew told {{an|May}} that he and Roselia would not be competing in the Chrysanthemum Contest, as they had participated in several competitions lately and could use a break. In ''[[AG180|May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!]]'', Drew and Roselia arrived at the [[Indigo Plateau]] for the [[Kanto Grand Festival]]. Roselia teamed up with [[Solidad]]'s {{p|Slowbro}} to calm down a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{AP|Aipom}} that was causing trouble in the [[Pokémon Center]]. Solidad revealed that Drew had used Roselia in his very first [[Pokémon Contest]], in which he managed to reach the final round before losing to her. In ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard!]]'', Roselia was used alongside {{p|Masquerain}} in the {{wp|Single-elimination tournament|eighth-finals}} against a {{p|Medicham}} and a {{p|Loudred}}. Roselia [[Contest combination|combined]] its Petal Dance with Masquerain's Silver Wind to create a powerful attack, which left the opponents unable to continue battling. As a result, the [[Contest Judge|judges]] ruled {{DL|Fainting|Battle Off}} for the opposing team, and Drew was declared the winner of the match. [[File:Drew Roselia Butterfree.png|thumb|250px|Roselia battling alongside Butterfree against May]] In ''[[AG187|The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing]]'', Roselia was used in a [[Double Battle|two-on-two]] [[Contest Battle]] alongside Drew's Butterfree against [[May's Combusken]] and {{TP|May|Beautifly}}. With a {{m|Psychic}} powered Fire Spin heading in their direction, Roselia blasted though it with Petal Dance. Afterwards, Beautifly used the sparks from the Fire Spin in combination with Psychic to attack once again; Roselia defended against them with Magical Leaf, though the attack was burned up. This allowed Combusken to go in for an attack but Butterfree used {{m|Gust}} to send Roselia's flaming Magical Leaf at its opponents. Roselia used Petal Dance which ended up absorbing power from Beautifly's on coming Silver Wind and dealing massive damage to it and Combusken. Combusken, however, broke through with {{m|Overheat}}, though Roselia was shielded by Butterfree's {{m|Protect}}. They then combined Solar Beam and {{m|Psybeam}} to win the battle. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== In ''[[DP076|A Full Course Tag Battle!]]'', May revealed that Roselia accompanied Drew to [[Johto]] and [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Roserade. In ''[[DP079|Strategy With a Smile!]]'', it watched the finals of the [[Wallace Cup]] with Drew, [[Solidad]], and [[Harley]]. ===Personality and characteristics=== As a Roselia, it was very loyal towards its Trainer, following his commands without question and always giving its all during its performances. It was also very strong, talented and in sync with its Trainer not only in Pokémon Contests, but in regular battles as well, being able to take on opponents with type advantages such as [[May's Combusken]] and [[Ash's Swellow|Ash's Taillow]]. It is, however, usually overpowered when battling more experienced coordinators like [[Solidad]], [[Robert (Hoenn)|Robert]], [[Grace (Hoenn)|Grace]], and [[Timmy Grimm|The Phantom]]. In Pokémon Contests, Roselia performs its moves with elegance and gracefulness during both the [[Appeal|Performance]] and [[Contest Battle|Battle]] stages, and has shown strong teamwork with its Trainer's other Pokémon in [[Double Battle]]s. Outside of Pokémon Contests, Roselia was occasionally seen outside its Poké Ball walking by its Trainer's side. It was shown to be quite cheerful and friendly, usually approaching and greeting May voluntarily as well as laughing at its Trainer whenever he gets flustered or teased about his gestures and relationship with her. It was also shown to be very helpful and intelligent in situations, such as tricking [[Team Rocket]] by shooting Petal Dance in the complete wrong direction, thus allowing the wind to blow the attack back and cut the rope May had been tied up in. It was also by its Trainer's side when he went backstage at the [[Mulberry City|Mulberry]] Contest, silently investigating [[Harley]] and Team Rocket's plan to sabotage May's final Contest in Kanto. The silent communication between it and its Trainer during the investigation proves the strong bond they share together. It was also shown to work well with other Trainers' Pokémon, such as blasting Team Rocket away by combining its {{M|Solar Beam}} with [[Ash's Pikachu]]'s {{M|Thunderbolt}} during its debut appearance, and stopping [[Aipom (anime)|Aipom]]'s chaos alongside Solidad's {{P|Slowbro}}. It is presumed to still retain these traits as a Roserade during its time in Johto, as May mentioned when she travelled to Sinnoh that it and Drew are still very strong and she had not been able to beat them. This was used to send Team Rocket blasting off after they had tried to steal [[Bluk Berry|Bluk Berries]] meant for [[Mr. Big]]. |} ==In the manga== ===Ash & Pikachu=== [[File:Drew Roselia AP.png|thumb|200px|Roselia in Ash & Pikachu]] Roserade appeared as a Roselia in [[Ash & Pikachu]], where it was Drew's principal Pokémon. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|grass|poison|Drew Roselia {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Petal Dance|1=Magical Leaf|2=Stun Spore|3=SolarBeam}} AP.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Petal Dance|1=Magical Leaf|2=Stun Spore|3=Solar Beam}}}} {{anmov|grass|Petal Dance|SP21|The Enchanting Pokémon Soul!}} {{anmov|grass|Magical Leaf|SP21|The Enchanting Pokémon Soul!}} {{anmov|grass|Stun Spore|SP21|The Enchanting Pokémon Soul!}} {{anmov|grass|Solar Beam|SP21|The Enchanting Pokémon Soul!}} {{anmov/f|poison}} ==Trivia== * As a Roselia, its size was inconsistent between episodes, but it was always [[Size discrepancies in the animated series|much larger than regular Roselia]]. * Roserade is the only one of Drew's Pokémon that has been seen in two evolutionary stages. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Roselia|Roserade}} {{-}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Roserade}} [[Category:Rivals' Pokémon]] [[de:Drews Roserade]] [[es:Roserade de Drew]] [[fr:Roserade de Drew]] [[it:Roserade di Drew]] [[ja:シュウのロズレイド]] [[zh:小瞬的罗丝雷朵]]
